report_identity.report_title: Tongda Group Holdings Limited Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: Tongda Group is a precision structural components manufacturer for smart mobile communications and consumer products, covering handset casings, smart electrical appliance panels, network communication facilities, and household and sports goods.

segments.name: Consumer electronics structural components
segments.source: 2024 annual report note 4, geographical/segment revenue table, annual report p.87

segments.name: Other product lines including smart electrical appliances, network communications facilities, household and sports goods
segments.source: 2024 annual report note 4 and MD&A business review, annual report pp.9, 87

business_overview.revenue_model: Sale of manufactured goods; performance obligation is satisfied on delivery and payment is generally due within one to three months, except new customers normally pay in advance.
business_notes: The high-precision components business was disposed of in April 2024, so 2024 revenue is not directly comparable with 2023.
Gross loss in 2024 was driven by business mix after disposal, intensified competition, and HK$508.9 million inventory provision.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported losses in 2023-2024 are dominated by impairments and business restructuring, while 2024 operating cash flow was supported by working-capital release, especially payables and other receivables. Three-year operating free cash flow median is only HK$84.232 million, so the owner-earnback denominator uses that as pre-haircut distributable cash profit and then applies a heavy 0.30 cash-profit haircut.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company, Hong Kong/offshore subsidiaries and Mainland operating subsidiaries, except for RMB-denominated group cash.
The annual report does not identify exact maintenance versus growth capital expenditure; purchases of PPE are used as a conservative proxy.

The rough-screen market-cap input appears to mix a post-consolidation adjusted price with pre-consolidation share count; the owner-earnback result uses a corrected 50-for-1 adjustment and records this as a limitation.
